while IFS= read -r line; do
  loc="${line%%: unreachable func: *}"
  fn="${line##*unreachable func: }"
  file="${loc%%:*}"; lno=$(echo "$loc" | cut -d: -f2)
  base="${fn##*.}"
  refs=$(grep -rIn --include='*.go' -w "$base" . 2>/dev/null \
    | grep -v '^\./vendor/' \
    | grep -vE ':[0-9]+:[[:space:]]*(//|\*|/\*)' \
    | grep -v "^\./$file:$lno:")
  n=$(printf '%s' "$refs" | grep -c . )
  echo "$n|$line" >> $SP/verified2.txt
done < $SP/all-cand.txt

content.text:
Done — draft PR: https://github.com/entireio/cli/pull/1855

## What I found

Pulled main forward 179 commits first (there was a stale `deadcode-all.txt` in your working tree from an earlier session — its entries were already outdated, e.g. `renderBrailleChart` no longer exists).

Raw `deadcode` output is misleading on this repo, so I didn't delete straight from it:

- Without `-test`, every `*ForTest` / `*ForTesting` seam looks dead (40 hits) — deleting those would have broken tests.
- With `-test`, results swing hard with build tags: 106 hits plain, 107 with `integration`, but only 3 with `e2e`, because e2e entry points make RTA consider almost everything reachable.

So I pooled candidates from all four passes (146 total) and cross-checked each against a repo-wide reference search that ignores build tags and skips doc comments. **4 of 146 had zero real call sites.** The other 142 are all genuinely live — the `e2e/testutil` and `e2e/entire` helpers are used under the `e2e` tag, and the test seams are called from `_test.go` files.

## Deleted

| Location | Symbol |
|---|---|
| `integration_test/interactive.go` | whole file — `TestEnv.RunCommandInteractive`, `WaitForPromptAndRespond` |
| `integration_test/remote_operations_test.go:739` | `getRemoteBranchHash` |
| `integration_test/testenv.go:2044` | `TestEnv.RunPrePushWithStdin` |

`interactive.go` was the only importer of `github.com/creack/pty`, so that dependency left `go.mod` via `go mod tidy`. `RunPrePushWithStdin` was a pass-through to `runPrePush`, which `RunPrePushWithError` still uses — the pre-push helpers are intact.

All four escaped the `unused` linter (it is enabled in `.golangci.yaml`) because it doesn't run over `integration`-tagged files.

## Verification

`mise run lint` 0 issues; `mise run test:ci` green (437 integration tests with 1 pre-existing skip, Vogon 59/59, roger-roger 4/4); `go vet` clean under default, `integration`, and `e2e` tags; and a re-run of `deadcode -test -tags=integration` shows no cascading dead code.

Two caveats worth naming: `deadcode` only analyzes functions, so unused types/consts/vars in tagged files aren't covered by this sweep, and I deliberately left the 142 verified-live symbols alone rather than trusting the e2e pass's narrow output.
